bug_semantics: An action argument declared as type url is validated only as URI syntax. The accepted user value is then inserted verbatim into the administrator-defined Shell template and executed through sh -c. URI validation does not quote or neutralize shell syntax, so shell metacharacters within an otherwise valid URI cross the source-to-sink path and can alter the command.
